items.title: Ukraine rescuers pull dead from rubble after Russian strikes kill 18 people
items.description: An eight-year-old boy and a woman killed in a strike on an apartment block are among the dead, officials say.

items.title: Clashes continue in Lebanon despite Israel and Hezbollah accepting US partial ceasefire plan
items.description: A cessation of hostilities between Israel and Hezbollah is seen as crucial to the peace process with Iran.

items.title: Two people shot dead amid Kenya protests against US Ebola quarantine centre plan
items.description: The US plan has sparked public anger and led to demonstrations near the site of the proposed treatment facility.

items.title: Instagram AI chatbot tricked by hackers to give access to others' accounts
items.description: Some reports have linked the incident to recent cases of high-profile Instagram accounts being hijacked.

items.title: Denmark's Mette Frederiksen to form government after months of negotiations
items.description: The leader of Denmark's Social Democratic Party is forming a centre-left coalition minority government, giving her a third term as prime minister.

items.title: Sabrina Carpenter gets restraining order against man who showed up at her home
items.description: The singer reported a series of "deeply alarming" incidents at her house to Los Angeles police.

items.title: Maga influencer admits London Tube station assault
items.description: Melissa Rein Lively accepted a caution, while an assault by beating charge against her was withdrawn.

items.title: China goes after 'ghost kitchens' to rein in cut-throat food delivery apps
items.description: The thousands of "ghost kitchens" - online shops that don't actually exist - have spooked Chinese consumers.

items.title: Trump administration will abide by ruling halting $1.8bn 'anti-weaponisation' fund
items.description: The justice department says it  "disagrees strongly" with a court decision to halt the establishment of the fund.

items.title: Australian ex-minister launches crowd-funded inquiry into Aukus submarine deal
items.description: Inquiry will look at whether Australia will receive the submarines and whether it will make the country safer.

items.title: AI giant Anthropic plans to sell shares in US as valuation nears $1tn
items.description: The AI company behind Claude is set to offer the public the chance to buy and sell shares in the firm later this year.

items.title: Missing lab worker found dead in New Mexico nearly a year after disappearing
items.description: Melissa Casias' case was part of debunked speculations about recent deaths and disappearances in the US scientific community.
